requirements.requirement: The system must define a Pydantic input model that accepts a raw user condition query string.
The system must define a Pydantic input model that accepts a list of normalized condition terms.
The system must define a Pydantic input model that accepts a list of trial condition strings.
The system must define an output schema containing a relevance_score field constrained between 0 and 1 inclusive.
The system must define an output schema containing a match_type field with enumerated values (exact, partial, semantic, none).
The system must define an output schema containing a matched_terms list capturing overlapping or related terms.
The system must define an output schema containing explanation fields describing why the relevance_score was assigned.
The system must ensure all schema fields are serializable to JSON without transformation errors.
The system must validate that relevance_score defaults to 0 when no valid inputs are provided.
The system must reject inputs where trial conditions list is null with a validation error.
The system must allow empty normalized condition terms while still producing a valid output schema.
The system must ensure compatibility of the input schema with existing clinical_trials_models structures without requiring field renaming.
The system must produce deterministic outputs for identical inputs under the scoring contract.
The system must ensure the explanation field references matched_terms when matches exist.
The system must handle invalid input types (e.g., non-string query, non-list conditions) by raising schema validation errors.
The system must ensure the match_type is 'none' when relevance_score equals 0.
